ITEM 1 | Crispy strips of cooked meat, reddish-brown with darker caramelized edges and pale fatty streaks, glossy and slightly oily, flat thin strips about 1 cm wide and 12-15 cm long, curled over the upper left of the plate, lying on the plate beside the eggs and greens | 45

ITEM 2 | Soft scrambled eggs, pale yellow with mixed lighter and deeper yellow curds, moist and fluffy with a crumbly, clumpy texture, no visible browning, forming an irregular mound about 10 cm across and 2 cm high in the lower left of the plate | 150

ITEM 3 | Stir-fried green vegetables, bright green flat pods and sliced stalks with glossy sheen, mixed with thin orange carrot matchsticks about 5 cm long and a few scattered green herb bits, wilted but still holding shape, piled in a mound about 8 cm long and 3 cm high in the upper right of the plate | 70

ITEM 4 | Thin orange carrot matchsticks, bright orange, slightly glossy, about 0.3 cm thick and 4-5 cm long, scattered among the green vegetables and a few loose on the plate surface | 10
